dog.description_text:
Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way…! That’s the tune you’ll surely be humming once you meet Jingles, a 1-year old, 11-pound tuxedo cat who is as handsome as he is sweet. And what a loud purr he has. You can hear his little engine humming from all the way across the room!

Jingles is litter-pan trained, an expert self-groomer, and always appears neatly attired but for his adorably mismatched socks! ;-). He eats with gusto, he’s 110% interested in treats, and he is very welcoming of the human touch. He even comes when you call his name!

Jingles doesn’t show much interest in toys, but this fella is as sociable as they come. He adores other cats, he’s super friendly toward adults and kids alike, and he is a cuddler extraordinaire. Happy and curious, Jingles is a pretty chill dude who easily adapts to his surroundings. Naturally, Jingles has his playful moments, but not in an overly hyper way. Mellow and easy-going, he plays respectfully with other kitties and seems to really enjoy their company.

If you’re in the market for a young, beautiful cat who is full of life, love, and joy, Jingles is ready to steal your heart and be your new favorite furry feline.

If you would like to adopt this wonderful cat, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
